prompts.office:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE production pixel art animation atlas for office for the game Chomp Chomp Panic.
Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the kaiju's charming chunky pixel clusters, single logical pixel #10152D dark navy outline, flat 2-3 tone shading and saturated highlights. Do not include the kaiju in the output.
Atlas layout: EXACTLY SIX COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of perfectly equal SQUARE cells, aspect ratio 3:1, ideally 3072x1024. Transparent background with no dividers, text, labels, shadows or ground. Row 1 has SIX character frames. Row 2 has FOUR character frames in columns 1-4; columns 5-6 completely transparent.
Subject: OFFICE WORKER: light peach skin, neatly swept dark brown hair, white shirt with a clearly visible violet necktie, brown/slate trousers and dark shoes. Big open AAH mouth.
Tiny cute cartoony city human in PANIC, hilarious and adorable. Strict SIDE VIEW FACING RIGHT, nose points right, one visible eye, hair/backpack behind to left. Enormous head, tiny compact torso and very short stubby limbs, ONLY 2 to 2.5 heads tall. Arms flailing above shoulders beside head, visibly running scared. No gore.
Sprite is intended to be only 18-22 pixels tall on a 32x32 logical grid. Render extremely coarse intentional pixel art, each small character contained in the central 20x22 region of its 32x32 cell, using about 9 logical pixels for the head, 6 for torso, 5 for feet/legs, with silhouette margins all around. NO intricate features or dithering or texture or gradients or antialiasing. Broad flat 2-3 tone color regions. Keep the fine features very simple and readable at 22 pixels tall. A big two-pixel open dark mouth, single eye pixel and recognizable clothing details.
ROW 1: six frame frantic RUN loop with obvious leg changes: 1 forward stride extended right leg and back left leg; 2 feet passing; 3 opposite leg extending; 4 opposite wide stride; 5 feet passing opposite; 6 recovery. Flail arms between slightly different raised angles. Fixed torso/head size and orientation all frames. Consistent head, clothing and hair between frames.
ROW 2: four frame panicked IDLE on-the-spot wave cycle: 1 arms up at head sides; 2 one arm raises; 3 both arms raised; 4 other arm raises. Both stubby feet stay at same baseline in all frames. No turning left or front.
All frames centered identically in equal cells, SAME FOOT BASELINE and head height. Same scale all 10 frames. Leave generous empty cell margins. No blue/teal clothing. LIMITED warm shared-palette look, #10152D silhouette outlines, ivory highlights. Whole atlas transparent.
